'''Tibris''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Considered to be mad, Tibris ordered the extermination of all life on [[Bhargebba Six]], but allowed biologists to take samples prior to the extermination.<ref name="Mission" />
